displayTitle: The Blacksmith They Dared Not Let into Hell
description: An English retelling that stays close to the original folktale: the boastful blacksmith makes a bargain for unmatched skill, receives three crafty wishes from the Lord, outwits the Devil again and again, and finally finds both Hell barred and Heaven narrowing shut.
summary: A blacksmith with three cunning wishes traps the Devil, only to discover neither Hell nor Heaven is eager to admit him.
